goal: Build a complete 4-week Instagram campaign: brand foundation, content calendar, captions, and visual direction.

milestones.title: Campaign Brief
milestones.goal: Lock the month window, theme, platforms, and anchor dates before generating assets.
milestones.data:
## Campaign Brief

**Start date:** <!-- YYYY-MM-DD -->
**End date:** <!-- YYYY-MM-DD (should span ~4 weeks) -->
**Monthly theme:** <!-- e.g. Spring lunch spotlight -->
**Social platforms in scope:** <!-- e.g. Instagram Feed, Reels, Stories -->
**Brand voice notes:** <!-- e.g. warm, confident, value-clear -->
**Campaign objective:** <!-- e.g. Grow dinner covers on Thu–Sat -->
**Key menu items or categories:** <!-- comma-separated -->
**Target guest:** <!-- e.g. local families, office lunch -->
**Post cadence:** <!-- e.g. 5 posts/week -->
**Special events or holidays in window:** <!-- list dates or write "none" -->
**Budget or constraints:** <!-- e.g. no paid ads, in-house photos only -->

passCriteria.requirement: Start date is specified (YYYY-MM-DD or clear equivalent).
End date is specified and is on or after the start date.
At least one special event or holiday in the window is noted, or the brief explicitly says "none".

milestones.title: Location Profile
milestones.goal: Document operating snapshot and positioning hints from POS data for downstream creative work.

passCriteria.requirement: Peak periods or traffic pattern is documented.
Guest behavior section is present (when/how people order).
Positioning hints or implications for messaging are listed.

milestones.title: Brand Brief
milestones.goal: Establish pillars, tone, audience hypotheses, and proof-oriented angles from analytics.

passCriteria.requirement: 3–5 content pillars are defined and tied to categories or operating signals.
Tone guardrails are documented (3–5 bullets or equivalent).
At least one proof-oriented menu angle cites category mix or hero/trending items from the data.

milestones.title: 4-Week Content Calendar
milestones.goal: Produce a four-week Instagram-first calendar with formats, pillars, and featured items per slot.

passCriteria.requirement: All four weeks (Week 1–4) are covered with planned slots.
Each week includes at least three post slots.
Content mix reflects weekly demand pattern (e.g. promotional bias in lower-demand weeks when data supports it).
Each slot specifies format (e.g. Reel, Carousel, Feed, Story).

milestones.title: Caption Batch
milestones.goal: Write hook, body, CTA, and hashtags for each calendar slot in brand voice.

passCriteria.requirement: Every calendar slot has a corresponding caption block.
Each caption includes a hook, body, CTA, and hashtag block.

milestones.title: Visual Creative Brief
milestones.goal: Define shot lists, Reel hooks, and Story sequences aligned to the calendar and promotion signals.

passCriteria.requirement: Each of four weeks has a shot list or equivalent visual plan.
A Reel hook or first-frame note is specified for each week.
A Story sequence (multi-slide outline) is described for each week.
